findings: All accounting requirements met: purchase currency preserved, payment currency preserved, applied_amount tracks USD liability, carrying value uses R₀, FX gain/loss recognized correctly, journal balances in base currency (verified via three algebraic proofs in plan + test assertions).

FX gain/loss amounts correct: loss = cashBase − carryingBase (positive diff), gain = carryingBase − cashBase (negative diff, negated for credit). Exchange loss test: Dr Payable 12,000,000 SYP + Dr Loss 500,000 SYP = Cr Cash 12,500,000 SYP ✓. Exchange gain test: Dr Payable 12,000,000 SYP = Cr Cash 11,800,000 SYP + Cr Gain 200,000 SYP ✓.
Journal balancing in base currency enforced: cross-currency path uses base_debit/base_credit independently of nominal debit/credit, so mixed-currency entries balance. Same-currency path unchanged.

Same-currency regression preserved: postPaymentJournal takes the two-line path when appliedCurrency == currency; PaymentAccountingTest (13/13) and PartnerPaidPurchaseTest (15/15) confirmed passing in FEAT findings.
No scope leaks: resolveAccountId, resolveForexAccountId, assertCurrencyMatchesAccount, resolvePayable all use withoutGlobalScope(CompanyScope::class) and enforce company_id checks explicitly.

Atomicity preserved: recordSupplierPayment and recordPartnerPaidPurchase wrap recordPayment + postPaymentJournal in a single DB::transaction; rollback test confirms no partial records on invalid FX account.
calculateOutstandingFor correctly uses bcdiv (not bcmul) to convert SYP payment amount → USD: USD = SYP ÷ rate. Test #6 confirms this.
Migration 2026_10_11_000000_add_forex_accounts_to_companies.php present with correct nullable FKs and nullOnDelete behavior; Company model updated with fillable fields and BelongsTo relationships.

MINOR GAP — no dedicated test for 'missing or invalid exchange rates' scenario: the plan required a test verifying that recordSupplierPayment throws when no exchange rate record exists and none is supplied. This scenario is partially guarded by preparePaymentAttributes (resolveExchangeRate throws), but there is no explicit test case for it in CrossCurrencySettlementTest. The behavior is correct in the implementation; the coverage gap is low-risk since all other test paths pass.

MINOR GAP — no dedicated same-currency regression test in CrossCurrencySettlementTest itself: the plan listed it as a required test. Same-currency coverage exists in PaymentAccountingTest and PartnerPaidPurchaseTest (both confirmed passing), but the new test file does not include an explicit same-currency supplier payment test. Not a blocking issue.

MINOR GAP — guardPaymentAgainstOverpayment contains a bcmul branch (converting applied_amount when applied_currency != payableCurrency) that is never exercised by current tests, because preparePaymentAttributes normalizes applied_currency to the payable currency before recordPayment is called. The branch is unreachable in the normal flow but its multiplication direction would be wrong if triggered directly (should divide, not multiply, to go from base currency to purchase currency). Not a regression risk for any current test path.
Full suite: 163/163 tests pass, 441 assertions, 0 failures, exit code 0 (per FEAT-002 findings).
